instruments.title: Merchant Shipping Act, 1958 (as amended)
instruments.summary: Principal Indian statute governing merchant shipping — registration, certification, safety, crew and liability.

instruments.title: International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS), 1974
instruments.summary: Core IMO convention on ship safety — construction, fire protection, life-saving, radio, navigation.

instruments.title: International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL)
instruments.summary: Annexes I–VI: oil, chemicals, packaged goods, sewage, garbage and air emissions from ships.

instruments.title: Merchant Shipping (Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping) Rules, 2014
instruments.issuedBy: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
instruments.summary: Indian implementation of STCW 2010 (Manila amendments) — competency, certification and watchkeeping.

instruments.title: Monsoon working restrictions — West Basin and outer anchorage
instruments.summary: Cape vessels to maintain 20% additional UKC at WB berths during SW monsoon; bunkering suspended at outer anchorage above sea state 5.
instruments.body: During the South-West monsoon period, all capesize vessels berthing at WB-1/WB-2 shall maintain an additional 20% under-keel clearance over the declared minimum. Bunker barge operations at the outer anchorage stand suspended whenever sea state exceeds 5 or wind exceeds 25 knots sustained. Masters shall confirm compliance on the pre-arrival checklist.

instruments.title: Electronic port clearance — mandatory FAL declarations via portal
instruments.summary: All agents to submit FAL 1–7 declarations electronically; paper submissions cease from effective date.
instruments.body: Pursuant to the FAL Convention (2022 amendments), all shipping agents shall lodge General Declaration, Cargo Declaration, Ship Stores, Crew Effects, Crew List, Passenger List and Dangerous Goods declarations through the port community interface. Paper declarations will not be accepted after the effective date except for declared system outages.

instruments.title: Revised garbage reception fees under MARPOL Annex V
instruments.summary: Garbage reception charge revised; segregation certificate required from vessels landing >2 m³.

instruments.title: Anchorage allocation policy — priority matrix
instruments.summary: Superseded by PORT-N-07/2026 for monsoon months.

instruments.title: Security level 1 in force — access control reminders
instruments.summary: MARSEC Level 1 continues; dock passes to be displayed; crew shore leave via Gate 3 only.

instruments.title: Cyclone Biparjoy — contingency berthing restrictions, Kutch coast
instruments.summary: Precautionary berthing suspension and vessel evacuation to sea ahead of Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Biparjoy making landfall near Jakhau, Kutch.
instruments.body: Following IMD tracking of Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Biparjoy, all vessels alongside shall complete cargo operations and vacate berths by 1800 hrs on 14 June 2023, proceeding to open sea or a designated safe anchorage. Port operations will remain suspended until an all-clear survey of berths, cranes and navigational aids is completed after landfall.

instruments.title: Pre-arrival notification format revised — IMO FAL forms
instruments.summary: Interim paper/email FAL format ahead of the portal single-window rollout. Superseded by CIRC-12/2026.

instruments.title: Container VGM verification procedure at the gate
instruments.summary: Verified Gross Mass to be declared and weighed at the terminal gate for all export containers per SOLAS Ch VI reg 2.
instruments.body: Shipping agents and CHAs shall submit VGM via Method 1 (weighing the packed container) at the terminal gate weighbridge; Method 2 (calculated) declarations must carry the shipper's certified weighing procedure on file. Containers without a VGM record on file will not be permitted to load.
